evals.prompt: Use Steward Frame for this request: On the empty Sources page, change the title from “No sources found” to “No sources yet.” Nothing else changes. Draft only; do not approve or implement.
evals.expected_output: A tiny format-v3 contract with the requested outcome and one or two acceptance claims, without critique ceremony or an implementation plan.
expectations: The body contains Outcome and Acceptance and is no more than 150 words.
The contract contains one or two AC identifiers and no I, R, EV, or P identifiers.
The contract does not invent analytics, localization, accessibility, migration, monitoring, or redesign work.
The contract contains no evidence plan, probe inventory, risk inventory, or open question.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Frame for this request: Consolidate the two duplicate role-expression parsers into one shared implementation. This is an internal refactor: supported inputs, parsed results, and error behavior must remain unchanged. Draft only; do not approve or implement.
evals.expected_output: A concise preservation contract that records the behavior boundary without choosing modules, APIs, dependencies, rollout mechanics, or test files.
expectations: The contract contains one to three acceptance claims and is no more than 250 words.
At least one claim preserves observable parsing results and error behavior.
The contract does not prescribe a module, function signature, dependency direction, rollout plan, or test filename.
The response does not require an independent critique for this routine refactor.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Critique on this draft. Outcome: Division administrators can export employees from the division they administer. Scope: preserve the invariant that division administrators cannot access employees outside their administered divisions. Acceptance: AC1 says a division administrator can download the employee CSV for an administered division. Produce findings only.
evals.expected_output: A revise-minimally recommendation with one contract defect: the named authorization invariant needs an observable negative acceptance claim.
expectations: The recommendation is revise-minimally.
The report contains one contract defect and no more than two findings total.
The defect explicitly protects the administered-division authorization boundary.
The minimal resolution is a negative claim that denies an out-of-scope division without exposing its employee data.
The critique does not demand rate limiting, audit storage, encryption changes, JWT changes, monitoring, rollback, browser matrices, or CSV formatting details.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Frame for this request: Show Slack integration status in admin. Use configuration and ordinary route-health information only when it already exists. Label configured state as “Configured,” not “Connected.” Do not add synthetic monitoring, a server-held diagnostic identity, credentials, or a live Slack probe. Real authenticated usability is validated separately by an operator using Slack. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: A small contract describing honest status labels, available health evidence, and the external validation boundary without inventing observability infrastructure.
expectations: The contract has two to four acceptance claims and is no more than 400 words.
It distinguishes configured state from authenticated usability.
A lack of existing route-health evidence is not labeled unreachable or broken.
It adds no monitoring, credentials, diagnostic identity, live API call, or background job.
Separate operator validation remains an external boundary rather than an automated contract requirement.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Frame for this synthetic regression: reshape integration administration around endpoint-owned surfaces. The overview owns shared status and safe next actions. Records detail preserves deployed operator controls and authorization/publication safety. Search detail exposes only real endpoint controls. Video gets no detail page until it owns meaningful controls. Connections, Access Policy, Chat Gateway, and audit/token/security remain shared. Direct links, reload, history, fallback, permissions, and no protected-content flash must remain safe. Status labels must distinguish configured from authenticated usability. Decide the consumer-backed target and migration behavior for display name, owner contacts, and freshness settings. Do not add synthetic monitoring, canaries, diagnostic identities, credentials, live protocol probes, or a monitoring subsystem; real authenticated validation is performed separately by an operator/client. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: A bounded format-v3 umbrella contract or a split recommendation that preserves the product decisions without becoming an endpoint, permission, component, or test matrix.
expectations: The result has no more than eight acceptance claims and no more than 1100 body words, or recommends a small outcome-oriented split.

It covers shared overview, Records detail preservation, real Search controls, no premature Video detail, shared administration, navigation and authorization safety, honest status labels, and consumer-backed settings migration.
It adds no canary, diagnostic principal, credential, authenticated server probe, live protocol call, or monitoring subsystem.
It does not enumerate every endpoint, permission, component, response code, test case, or currently deployed control.
If critique is recommended, it is targeted to a demonstrable ambiguity or changed safety boundary.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Frame for this request: Replace the admin application with the new design system, migrate every page, redesign navigation, improve performance, preserve all permissions, add analytics, and clean up the routing architecture. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: A split recommendation with a small number of outcome-oriented slices rather than a giant monolithic contract.
expectations: The recommendation is split rather than approval-ready.
The response proposes no more than five outcome-oriented slices and no more than three material owner questions.
It does not fabricate a performance threshold, analytics taxonomy, rollout mechanism, component API, or permission model.
It does not generate more than seven provisional acceptance claims.
It explains which unresolved product decisions prevent meaningful assessment.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Critique for a delta-only second pass. The prior finding was that “filters are restored” did not say whether sort order was included. The revised contract says: Outcome: Returning from employee detail restores the employee-list view. AC1: Browser Back restores the search text, selected status filters, sort field, and sort direction that were active when detail was opened. AC2: Loading an employee-detail URL directly continues to work. No repository or product evidence has changed since the first pass.
evals.expected_output: A ready recommendation that recognizes the prior ambiguity is resolved and does not restart a general completeness review.
expectations: The recommendation is ready with zero blocker or major findings.
The report recognizes that the prior ambiguity is resolved.
It does not newly demand scroll restoration, pagination, mobile behavior, analytics, accessibility, performance budgets, browser matrices, telemetry, or rollback.
Any residual uncertainty is explicitly non-blocking.
The critique outputs findings only and does not create, copy, or rewrite a contract artifact.

evals.prompt: Use Steward Assess. The approved contract has AC1: Browser Back restores search text, selected status filters, sort field, and sort direction; and AC2: loading an employee-detail URL directly continues to work. The immutable post-build evidence pack contains a Playwright trace establishing AC1 and an existing route integration test establishing AC2. No evidence methods were declared before construction. Produce the claim-level assessment only; do not modify the implementation.
evals.expected_output: A passing assessment for exactly AC1 and AC2 using the strongest post-build evidence without requiring predeclared EV methods or inventing new criteria.
expectations: The assessment reports exactly AC1 and AC2 and records the supplied trace and test against the relevant claims.
Both claims pass when the supplied artifacts substantiate them.
The absence of predeclared EV identifiers does not cause failure or downgrade.
The assessment introduces no cross-browser, analytics, accessibility, or performance criteria.
Unavailable or inadequate evidence would produce inconclusive rather than a guessed result.
